releases.title: See what changed in every update
new: An in-app update log lists changes by version, with the installed version clearly marked.
Open Update log from the tray, the editor's bottom bar, or the Updates window.
Read the included version history even without an internet connection.
improved: New, improved, and fixed items are grouped so changes are easy to scan.

releases.title: A new logo across Windows
new: The bronze-and-ivory fan logo appears in the taskbar, Start menu, system tray, app, and installer.
improved: The logo includes sizes for small tray icons and larger Windows shortcuts.
The tray keeps its update-available badge.

releases.title: Gentle bloom opens settings
new: Tap the ellipsis to fill settings with bronze, like liquid spreading into the menu.
The bloom spreads from the radial center or downward through the docked rail, revealing ivory icons.
improved: The 760 ms animation stays within the existing menu outline; the dock remains 44 px wide.
Back or hide cancels the fill immediately. Reduced motion switches instantly.
Drawing actions pause during the fill, and settings become interactive when it finishes.

releases.title: Modifier buttons and easier editing
new: The default menu includes labeled Alt, Ctrl, and Shift buttons.
Hold a modifier to activate it. Drag out to keep it held for the current contact, then lift to release. Double-tap to keep it on until the next tap.
Choose Menu → Edit, then tap a button to open its inspector. Right-click also opens direct editing.
The radial's outer ring can switch to Dock, Edit, Sound, Glass, Hide, and Quit.
improved: Held modifiers release when hiding the menu, opening the editor, changing target apps, or quitting.
Customized menus are preserved. Unchanged old defaults upgrade automatically; other profiles can use the undoable Use new default menu action.

releases.title: The Continuous rail
new: One slim 44 px housing holds the docked tools and settings.
The top ellipsis switches to bronze settings with ivory icons inside the same rail. Back restores the drawing tools.
improved: Settings keep full-size pointer targets without opening a side panel.
Sound and Glass show a visible indicator when enabled.
Input and Glass boundaries follow the rail's narrow outline.

releases.title: Download and update from GitHub
new: The official GitHub update feed is preconfigured for Tablet Pro Radial.
Use Updates in the tray or editor to check, download, and install a newer release. Automatic checks can notify you when one is available.
improved: The installer includes the runtime, matching source, and third-party notices while keeping saved menus and preferences.
